title: Triage review of c44's low-noise layered CIPS claim on seed 6: 3 nucleations, then division alone fills the box (17 bodies, 14 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges), every body with an s rim; B and E not re-tested
summary: Labkit re-run of world.py at defaults on seed 6 (192^2, 250 frames, t=25000). From the weak random field (sheet t=0) 3 bodies nucleate by t~1100-2100; they and their descendants pinch into round daughters (dumbbells at t=3400, 6500-8600, 13000) until 17 bodies fill the box by t~15000, with no births after and no deaths: 14 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges. Radial s: rim/core 6.1, rim/outside 29.5, 77 of 81 individuals membrane-like.

observations.S: rerun/seed6/sheet.png t=0: smoothed random field over the whole box
observations.I: rerun/seed6/sheet.png t=1100-25000: separate round bodies, 17 at the end
observations.D: rerun/seed6/FACTS.md: 14 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges, 3 nucleations

verdicts.limitation: Generation 3 on this seed (the claim: 4 on 3 of 4 seeds, 3 on seed 1). I saw the s rim (rim/core 6.1, 77/81 membrane-like) but did not run the body-share or source-restricted check that the quasi-equilibrium clause asks for, nor the moat cut, so B and E are not checked here; births stop when the box fills.
